executiveSummary: Overall OT/ICS Threat Level HIGH Actively Exploited OT/Edge Items 8+ Notable New/Updated OT-Adjacent CVEs (7 days) 15+ Sectors Most At Risk Water/Wastewater, Energy, Transportation, Manufacturing, Buildings US agencies warn of an active threat to Siemens S7 PLCs using AI-generated snap7 tooling to probe S7comm (TCP/102); immediate removal of Internet exposure and hardening are urged Security Advisory . Iran-affiliated actors continue exploiting Internet-exposed PLCs (Rockwell, Schneider, Siemens) to change logic and disable alarms in US critical infrastructure Security Advisory . Pro-Russia hacktivists opportunistically target exposed VNC on OT HMIs/SCADA, causing loss of view/control events; remove public VNC and enforce MFA Security Advisory . Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-8452) with public PoC enables webshell placement on widely used remote access gateways-patch and hunt immediately JPCERT Advisory . FortiBleed dataset exposes 86k+ Fortinet credentials; many remain valid, enabling AD pivot and site-to-site VPN abuse. Enforce PBKDF2, rotate creds, and validate segmentation JPCERT Advisory . CISA bulletins highlight critical OT/edge CVEs: EV chargers (EVbee), OPC UA (Eclipse Milo), PcVue HMI, and others-prioritize patching and isolating device management planes Bulletin Bulletin . Confirmed UK power plant outage (4 days) underscores real OT disruption risk; investigate PLC and remote access exposures View Article .

relevance: Current activity clusters around three dominant risk themes for critical infrastructure: (1) direct PLC targeting (read-first reconnaissance with credible paths to write/logic changes); (2) exploitation of remote access and identity edge (NetScaler, SonicWall SMA, FortiGate credentials) providing realistic IT-to-OT pivot avenues; and (3) critical vulnerabilities in operational integration components (OPC UA servers, EVSE/OCPP, HMI/SCADA platforms) where segmentation gaps can lead to loss of control or disruptive DoS. Collectively, these observations sustain a HIGH threat level for OT defenders over the next week.

descriptions: Valid accounts and edge device exploitation for initial access: ATT&CK T1078, T1190.
Living-off-the-land in OT perimeters (PowerShell, BITS, xp_cmdshell): T1059, T1197, T1505.
Webshell placement on appliance/web gateways (NetScaler theme path, Tomcat): T1505.003.
Credential access via LSASS/AD/LDAP paths from compromised servers: T1003, T1552.
ICS-specific: PLC logic tampering, command/variable manipulation (ATT&CK for ICS T0831, T0829); unauthorized S7comm PUT/GET; VNC abuse for HMI manipulation.
C2 and exfil using cloud services (OneDrive) and residential/SOHO proxy infrastructure.

outlook72h: Expect continued scanning for Internet-exposed S7 and open VNC; prioritize external attack surface reduction and monitoring. Follow-on exploitation waves likely against unpatched NetScaler/SonicWall appliances given public PoCs and KEV momentum. Increase of opportunistic attacks on EVSE and OPC UA as proofs-of-concept circulate; tighten segmentation and apply virtual patching where needed. Anticipate credential replay from FortiBleed dataset; enforce MFA and device posture for administrative access paths.
